title: Lightning bolt with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='boltGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFE44D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD000'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Glow behind bolt -->
  <polygon points='52,5 30,50 48,50 40,95 72,42 52,42 64,5' fill='#FFB800' opacity='0.35' transform='translate(1,2)'/>
  <!-- Main lightning bolt -->
  <polygon points='52,5 30,50 48,50 40,95 72,42 52,42 64,5' fill='url(#boltGrad)' stroke='#FFEF99' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='40' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#2B1B5E'/>
  <ellipse cx='45.5' cy='38' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='40' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#2B1B5E'/>
  <ellipse cx='58.5' cy='38' rx='2.5' ry='3' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M43,52 Q50,62 58,52' fill='none' stroke='#2B1B5E' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FF8866' opacity='0.75'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='50' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#FF8866' opacity='0.75'/>
</svg>
